feeds.title: Open Vallejo
feeds.description: Featured News articles and Opinions that impact local community conversations. Open Vallejo is an award-winning, independent, non-partisan, nonprofit newsroom serving the public interest. We seek to illuminate a small city long burdened by police violence, corruption, and neglect.

feeds.title: The Vallejo Sun
feeds.description: The valley's trusted source of in-depth reporting about local government, policing, and extremist movements in the region. Get by-the-minute coverage of local news and events. The Vallejo Sun is an independent news publication illuminating Solano County, California.
